headline: Stock market: Athens' weapons in the "battle" for 2,600 points
summary: Athens stocks are targeting the 2,600-point level, with the first-half corporate results described as the main driver of the upward move. The article also refers to the market's recent performance.
why: The Athens General Index tracks major Greek listed companies, and Greece's market has been a focus for European investors seeking exposure to banks and utilities.
